posts.text: SEBI’s CAS consultation gets 20,000 responses — image 598×246 33.3 KB Source : moneycontrol SEBI has received around 20,000 comments on its consultation paper around the Closing Auction Session (CAS), market timings and derivative settlement methodology. That’s quite a jump from the roughly 3,500 responses reported a few days ago. It’s also more than three times the 6,000 responses SEBI received in 2024 on its consultation around curbing excessive F&O activity.
